name: OpenAlex Computer Science Papers Downsampled Source-Schema Subset
description: Downsampled OpenAlex works used as benchmark input for the papers web-data-integration usecase. The file preserves an OpenAlex-shaped source schema instead of the integrated schema. Rows are ordered like the schema-mapped OpenAlex subset so existing identity-resolution identifiers remain stable. Records are taken from the local OpenAlex source snapshots where available; missing DOI rows are represented in the same OpenAlex-shaped schema from the downsampled values.

variableMeasured.name: doi
variableMeasured.description: OpenAlex DOI value, usually represented as a DOI URL

variableMeasured.name: authorships
variableMeasured.description: OpenAlex authorship objects with author identity and raw author name fields

variableMeasured.name: primary_location
variableMeasured.description: OpenAlex primary location object, including source and landing page information where available

variableMeasured.name: biblio
variableMeasured.description: OpenAlex bibliographic page, volume, and issue object

variableMeasured.name: referenced_works_count
variableMeasured.description: Number of referenced works reported by OpenAlex

variableMeasured.name: cited_by_count
variableMeasured.description: Number of citations reported by OpenAlex
